evidence.quote: should_encrypt — In this mode, the connection attempts to establish MACsec encryption but will fall back to unencrypted communication if MACsec negotiation fails.

The encryption mode can be set during connection configuration and can be modified later. By default, new MACsec-enabled connections are set to "should_encrypt" mode to prevent potential connectivity issues during initial setup.
must_encrypt — In this mode, the connection requires MACsec encryption for all traffic. If MACsec negotiation fails or encryption cannot be established, the connection will not transmit any traffic.
